question: What rebates are available for a heat pump?
html:
We don't have a verified list of heat pump rebate amounts to share today. Rebates depend on your utility, your county and your current heating fuel, so the most accurate answer comes from a quick check of your address during an estimate.

What decides your rebate

  • Your electric and gas utility. Utility programs differ by service area. Our records don't hold current rebate schedules for any utility in our footprint.
  • Your current heating fuel. Homes moving off fuel oil or propane often fit different programs than homes already on gas. Many homes we serve heat with oil or propane (Punctual Pros market profile).
  • Program timing. Rebate programs open, change and close. We confirm status on the day we quote rather than relying on old figures.

Where heat pumps fit locally

CountyHomes heating with oil or propane
Perry44.5%
Lebanon37.6%
Berks30.0%
Adams27.7%
Lancaster25.2%
Ocean and Monmouth, NJMostly utility gas (78-81%)

(Punctual Pros market profile)

  • About 241k households in our nine-county Central PA core still use oil or propane. Across all 13 counties we serve, the figure is about 390k (Punctual Pros market profile).
  • Older homes are common here. Between 45% and 64% of homes were built before 1980, which often shapes equipment sizing and ductwork needs (Punctual Pros market profile).

How we'll help

  • We check which programs your address qualifies for before you commit.
  • We show the rebate as a separate line on your estimate, so the net price is clear.
  • For tax credits, please confirm eligibility with your tax preparer. We can't give tax or regulatory advice.

What would answer this precisely

  • Current rebate schedules from each electric and gas utility in our service area, mapped by zip code.
  • State and federal incentive status, verified as of Oct 8, 2026.
  • Manufacturer promotions on the equipment lines we install.

The roughly 390k oil and propane homes across our footprint are a large conversion base. Clear, address-specific rebate answers could turn website visits into booked heat pump estimates.

Next actions

  1. Compile a zip-code rebate table from current utility program pages for all 13 counties. Assign an owner to refresh it monthly.
  2. Add a rebate-check step to the AI booking and estimating flow, so quotes show net price.
  3. Target website and membership outreach first at Perry, Lebanon, Berks and Adams, where oil and propane use is highest.
  4. Track the rebate-assisted close rate by county. That will show whether rebates should anchor the Berks and Lebanon entry in the growth plan.
